versions.content: Support the UDS service 0x31 (RoutineControl) according to ISO 14229-1 Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support the ISO 14229-1 service 0x31 RoutineControl with all sub-functions Rationale: RoutineControl is an integral part of ISO 14229-1 and used in most ECUs for customer specific actions triggered by diagnostic services. AppliesTo: CP, AP Use Case: Diagnostic tester starts a routine in the server. Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1
